name: Route Card
description: A route at a glance: the line drawn over a contour map, its figures, a compact elevation profile that moves a dot along the map, and save and GPX actions.

props.name: route
props.description: The route: name, region, distance (km), ascent and descent (m), time (text such as "9 h 40 min"), grade ({ label, level } with level 1–5, shown as five pips), points, waypoints, and optionally mapKm and north.

props.name: route.points
props.type: { x: number; y: number; km: number; m: number; lat?: number; lon?: number }[]
props.description: The track in order. x and y place it on the map as fractions of the panel, which keeps a 21:11 shape; km is the distance along the route and m the altitude. With lat and lon the GPX download is built from them.

props.name: route.waypoints
props.type: { km: number; name: string; kind?: "peak" | "place"; label?: boolean }[]
props.description: Named points along the route. Peaks get a small triangle on the map; every waypoint gets a dot on the profile, and a label on the map unless label is false. The readout names a waypoint when the scrubber passes it.

props.name: route.mapKm
props.description: Kilometres across the map panel. When given, a scale bar is drawn in the corner.

props.name: route.north
props.description: Direction of north on the map in degrees clockwise from up, for the north arrow.

props.name: map
props.description: Image URL for the map panel, drawn under the route. It is muted at night.

props.name: saved
props.description: Controlled saved state of the Save toggle.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called by Download GPX with a GPX 1.1 document built from the points (null without coordinates). Without it the card saves the file itself as <route-name>.gpx.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Hovering, touching or arrow-keying the profile moves a dot along the route on the map. Other article props are passed through.
